notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
